course_description: The course provides students with knowledge of the principles and practice of risk communication focusing on the areas of environment and health. The course will provide an understanding of risk communication including approaches, challenges, and ethics. It will also provide guidance on how to plan risk communication and how to put the risk communication plan into action. There will be consideration of different communication contexts (e.g., face-to-face, media, and social media) and different risk contexts (e.g., crises). Students will gain practical skills that will be valuable to a wide range of professions that have to deal with risk.

course_aims: The aims of the course are to introduce you to the principles and practice of risk communication. From the course you will gain an understanding of relevant theories and key issues and challenges to consider when communicating about environmental and health risks.You will also gain knowledge about the practice of risk communication and how to go about planning risk communication. Overall the course aims to equip anyone who has to talk to people about risk with insights and skills to undertake this type of communication. ﾠﾠ

learning_outcomes.description: Understand theories, challenges and principles of risk communication
Identify the steps required to plan risk communication
Demonstrate good written risk communication and the principles that underpin it
Understand key issues related to different risk communication formats

assessment_details.title: Risk communication case study analysis
assessment_details.task_description: The aim of this assignment is to apply the knowledge, concepts and principles covered in Weeks 1 to 4 to analyse and understand a real-world example of risk communication. Through the case study analysis, you can reflect on what was done well and what could have been done better. You will choose a risk communication issue that focuses on environment and/or health. Your goal will be to conduct an analysis of the risk communication process in relation to that issue. The assignment has the following sections: Overview and brief timeline, description of the risk communication, reflection on the challenges, analysis of what was done well and what could have been improved. learning_activities.topic: Week 1 - Introduction The first seminar provides an introduction to the course and to risk communication theories. Learning outcomes: L01
Week 2 - Risk perceptions In Week 2 we talk about and engage in activities that relate to theories and factors that influence people's risk perceptions. Learning outcomes: L01

Week 3 - Risk communication challenges Risk communicators face a range of challenges when it comes to their task. This week we discuss the different types of challenges that are faced when communicating about risk. Learning outcomes: L01
Week 4 - Risk communication principles In Week 4 you will be presented with core principles that guide effective risk communication. Learning outcomes: L01

Week 5 - No formal class There are no classes in Week 5 to provide time to complete the first assessment. Assessment consultation will be provided in the usual seminar timeslot. Learning outcomes: L02
Week 6 - Planning risk communication (1) This is the first of two seminars focused on planning the process of risk communication. Learning outcomes: L02
Week 7 - Planning Risk Communication (2) This is the second of two seminars focused on planning the process of risk communication. Learning outcomes: L02
Week 8 - Information and visuals Week 8 focuses on putting risk communication into practice and, in particular, developing written and visual risk communication. Learning outcomes: L03, L04
Week 9 - No classes There are no classes scheduled in Week 9.
Week 10 - Face-to-face risk communication The seminar this week will discuss key principles relating to undertaking risk communication in face-to-face settings. Learning outcomes: L04

Week 11 - Stakeholders participation and risk communication The Week 11 seminar moves on to talk about the importance of stakeholder participation for the risk communication process. Learning outcomes: L04
Week 12 - Traditional and social media and risk communication In Week 12 we will discuss the role of traditional and social media in risk communication. Learning outcomes: L04
Week 13 -Risk communication evaluation The final seminar will touch on evaluating risk communication as well as providing time to consult about the final assessment. Learning outcomes: L05
